protocol: PROTOCOL_V3.md Addendum H and its clarification of 13:15 UTC; in sample only (entries before 2022-01-01; frames read with the parquet row filter ts < 2022-01-01; official trades read with entry_time < 2022-01-01 in the same call).
scope: Lead synthesis A of the lenses path, payoff and entry (and of the supplementary payoff round of the 13:15 clarification, whose six verdicts are in complement_verdicts.json and were not in the relayed JSON).

keep_rule.text: A change is kept if (1) its verdict is 'confirmed', or 'weakened' and (2) the verifier's own estimate of what is left after its attacks is positive on the yardstick that fits the change, and (3) the verifier does not itself put its best estimate at zero or below. Yardstick: for a change that alters the position size per unit of money risk or the time spent in the market (stop distance, trailing exit, longer hold) the gain per unit of swing (equal weekly swing, or the risk-adjusted figure the verifier reports), because the 13:15 clarification and Addendum G establish that a larger position or a longer exposure raises R per trade and the swings alike and is a stake decision, not a better trade; for other changes (early exits, entries) the gain in R at a constant stake. At most one change per sleeve: the largest remaining total-R gain on that yardstick, using the verifier's numbers after its attacks.
keep_rule.unverified_candidates: A qualifier of a lens that no independent verifier attacked has no verdict and cannot be kept (nq_btc_follow T3 and orb_asia_2d_buf10 S0.25n, ranks 1 of the payoff lens's declared ranking for their sleeves, and every lower-ranked qualifier).

ocm4:us100.source: payoff lens, verified in the 13:15 round
ocm4:us100.spec: frozen ocm4 except: the 15:55 NY exit is removed; trailing stop at 1 x U (U = daily ATR14, simple mean, = stop_dist / 0.3) from the best bid high (long) / ask low (short) since the fill, updated at each M1 close, used from the next bar; initial stop distance min(D, U) = D = 0.3 U (unchanged); time cap at the open of the first M1 bar at/after 15:55 NY on the entry's NY date + 4 business days (gl.exit_index; never earlier than the rule's own exit bar); one position at a time over all ocm4 orders; order not sent if the initial stop < 3 spreads of its fill bar

F1_brk_ridge_filter:ethusd.source: payoff lens, verified in the first round
F1_brk_ridge_filter:ethusd.spec: frozen F1 except: each order is first simulated alone with the rule's exits; if it is still open at the close of the bar before its 15:55 NY clock exit bar, exits there by the clock, and side x (bid close for a long / ask close for a short of that bar - fill) >= 1 x its initial risk (D = 2 A = stop_dist), its exit moves to the open of the first bar at/after 15:55 NY on the decision's NY date + 2 business days, capped at the last bar before the weekend closure of the entry's server week (Friday 23:54 server, gl.exit_index), never earlier than the rule's exit; stop unchanged; one position at a time over all F1 orders; order not sent if its stop < 3 spreads

brk72_24h_wd:btcusd.source: payoff lens, verified in the 13:15 round
brk72_24h_wd:btcusd.spec: frozen brk72 (with the recalc weekend wrapper) except: initial stop at 0.75 x the rule's distance (3 x ATR24) from the fill, fixed; same money risk, so R is measured on the new stop; exits unchanged; order not sent if 0.75 D < 3 spreads of its fill bar; one position at a time over all signals (re-entry after a stop-out)

donch4h_stop:xauusd.spec: frozen donch4h_stop except: initial stop AND trailing distance at 0.75 x 2 ATR14(4h) = 1.5 ATR; R on the new stop; entries and the 5-trading-day time exit unchanged; order not sent if the stop < 3 spreads; one position at a time over all touched brackets

orb_asia_2d_buf10:xauusd.source: payoff lens, verified in the 13:15 round
orb_asia_2d_buf10:xauusd.spec: frozen orb except: initial stop at F - side x 0.75 x |F - opposite level| (F = the simulator's stop-entry fill), fixed; R on the new stop; exits unchanged; order not sent if the stop < 3 spreads; one position at a time over all signals

implementation: My own code in r2/tracks/autopsy/synthesis_A/synth.py, written from the change texts above; the rules come from lab/r2/recalc.py sleeves() (crypto breakout through its wrapper; nq leader = in-sample us100 mids via set_leader); simulator goldlab.sim.simulate with r2.costs(sym) (fp) and, on the spread x1.5 frame, r2.costs(sym, 1.5) (stress). Cross-checks: (i) rule 2, the unchanged runs against the official rows with entry < 2022; (ii) each changed run against the payoff lens's stored trades of the same variant (trades_<name>__<sym>.parquet, read with entry_time < 2022).

runs_declared.unchanged: 10 sleeves x {fp, stress} = 20 runs (the broker refusal of stops under 3 spreads applied, its effect reported; the rule-2 check is made on the pure frozen run)
runs_declared.budget: 30 simulation runs, plus at most 6 identical re-runs if a bug forces one (each logged); nothing else is simulated except the truncation tests below
runs_declared.portfolio_assemblies: computed from the runs, no new simulation, one trials.jsonl line each: unchanged; all five changes at a constant stake; all five changes at equal weekly swing (each changed sleeve's stake scaled so that its weekly SD of R equals the unchanged sleeve's over 2018-02..2021-12, FP; the same factor for the stress assembly); each change alone at a constant stake and at equal swing. Each in fp and stress: 2 + 2 x 2 + 5 x 2 x 2 = 26 lines

truncation_tests: For each kept change, about 30 trades of 2018-2021 (half where the change acts, half random): the whole pipeline (frozen rule on the cut frame, the change, one position at a time) re-run on the in-sample frame cut (a) at a random bar inside the trade: the trade must still be open, with the same fill and initial stop; (b) right after its exit bar: same exit bar, price, reason and R. For H2 also (c) the decision recomputed on the frame that ends at the decision bar (the bar before the 15:55 bar). Results in truncation.json; these are tests, not variants.

windows.main: entries 2018-02-01 .. 2021-12-31 (the common window of the ten sleeves)
windows.early: entries before 2018-02-01, sleeves that trade then (gold from 2013, us100 from 2014, btc from 2017-05), reported apart, judging nothing

censoring: a trade still open when the in-sample frame ends (non-crypto: closed at the last bar by 'time' or 'eod'; crypto: 'eod') needs 2022 prices and is excluded everywhere (one donch4h_stop and one orb trade in the unchanged runs)

measures.per_trade: number of trades, expectancy in R (and euros earned per 100 euros risked = 100 x expectancy), win rate, average win, average loss, profit factor, total R, mean/sd of R per trade
measures.weekly: weekly sums of R booked at the exit, FP server weeks (server = New York + 7 h, weeks start Monday 00:00 server), every week of the window counted (empty weeks = 0): worst week, share of losing weeks, longest run of losing weeks (sum < 0), weekly Sharpe = mean/sd x sqrt(52)
measures.drawdown: maximum drawdown of the cumulative R booked at the exit, trade by trade in exit order, at a constant stake (also on weekly sums)

reading: In sample, optimistic by construction: the five changes were picked on these trades. The comparison is descriptive; the only test that counts is the single declared look at 2022-2025, then the demo account.
